name: Troupe Tales: The Runaway Circus
source:
Roll up, roll up! Get to know an arrogant acrobat, a caring cowboy, a meek magician, and a colourful clown. Will you save the circus or doom it?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
卷起来，卷起来！认识一个傲慢的杂技演员、一个充满爱心的牛仔、一个温顺的魔术师和一个色彩缤纷的小丑。你会拯救马戏团还是毁灭它？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
